name: ClipUGC
description: Hosted ClipUGC MCP server that makes vertical UGC videos for mobile apps with an AI influencer who keeps the same face. The agent creates a character, generates more looks of that face, makes 5 or 10 second clips, merges the app's screen recording and a hook into the clip, and downloads the finished video. Generation uses ClipUGC credits (free credits to try, paid plans for more). OAuth sign-in. The same tools also run locally with `npx -y clipugc mcp`.
author: ClipUGC
